notes:
- POC kickoff 2026-02-18. Primary ask: dedicated capacity that survives market-open spikes (09:30-10:00 ET) with predictable latency and cost.
- Workloads: interactive trading chat (avg ~220 tokens), embeddings bulk jobs overnight, reranking for compliance pipelines. Bursts: up to ~1k reqs/sec during market open for chat.
- Throughput targets: sustain 1,000 concurrent chat sessions -> ~3,500 reqs/min; token throughput target ~120k tokens/min steady, spikes x5.
- Latency SLOs proposed by customer: p95 <= 350ms for 128-token responses, p99 <= 900ms; for 512-token responses p95 <= 900ms. Customer emphasizes p99 during market-open must be <1s.
- Reserved GPU plan: customer prefers reserved pool (8x A100-equivalent) + warm pool of 2 GPUs. Requirement: burst to 10 GPUs within 90s; prefer option for burst capacity SLA.
- Autoscaling wishes: pre-warm ahead of market open (10min window), reactive scale-up on queue depth >50 OR avg GPU util >70% sustained for 30s. Scale-down cooldown 5m after util <30%.
- Queueing strategy: bounded request queue with overflow routing to quantized fallback model to protect SLOs. Require graceful degradation policy and metrics for warm-pool hit-rate.
- Warm pools: customer wants billing clarity for idle warm GPU hours vs reserved capacity. Also wants ability to vary warm pool size for known calendar events.
- Security: must include SSO/SAML, SOC2 type II evidence, ISO27001 optional, KMS/HSM integration for keys, and audit logs with 1 year retention. Data residency addendum required.
- SE action items: deliver autoscaling config template, cost delta for warm-pool options, sample runbook for market-open pre-warm sequence. Plan stress tests 2026-03-20 (spike and sawtooth patterns).
- Customer quote: "We cannot tolerate >1s p99 during market-open bursts — even short degradation causes trading loss."
- Next step: Redwood to submit scaling configs + estimated TCO for two warm-pool sizes; schedule runbook and legal review week of 2026-03-15.

workload_summary: Interactive low-latency chat with high market-open spikes; heavy nightly embedding jobs; occasional high-priority reranking. Sensitive to p99 spikes during business hours.
poc_requirements: 1) Spike test: 5x baseline for 10min; 2) Sustained load: 2x baseline for 60min; 3) Pre-warm validation: bring warm pool online 10min before simulated market-open; 4) Fallback behavior: overflow to quantized model and measure quality degradation.
sla_expectations: Dedicated pool availability >= 99.9%; latency SLOs as noted (p95/p99 by token length); incident response <= 15min for Sev1; credits/penalties on missed SLOs; data residency and audit clauses in final contract.
scaling_policies: Scale-up triggers: queue depth >50 OR avg GPU util >70% for 30s; spin-up target to meet queued requests with max add of 2 GPUs per 30s until burst cap. Warm-pool pre-warm 10min before known events. Scale-down: cooldown 5m after util <30% and queue depth 0. Fallback: route overflow to quantized model when queue length exceeds 200 or estimated spin-up >60s. Metrics: warm-pool hit rate, cold-start latency, queue depth histogram, per-model p95/p99 latency.
